func (d *hookFragment) attr() []gox.Modify {
	return []gox.Modify{
		doors.ARawHook{
			On: func(ctx context.Context, r doors.RequestRawHook) bool {
				if err != nil {
				}
			},
		},
		doors.AData{
		},
	}
}
elem (f *hookFragment) Main() {
	<script (f.attr()...)>
	</script>
}
type multiHookFragment struct {
}
func (d *multiHookFragment) attr() []gox.Modify {
	return []gox.Modify{
		doors.ARawHook{
			On: func(ctx context.Context, r doors.RequestRawHook) bool {
				body, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body())
				var str string
				json.Unmarshal(body, &str)
				d.mu.Lock()
				d.n++
				n := d.n
				if n == 3 {
					close(d.gate)
				}
				d.mu.Unlock()
				if n <= 3 {
					select {
					}
				}
			},
		},
	}
}
elem (f *multiHookFragment) Main() {
	~>doors.AClick{
		On: func(ctx context.Context, r doors.RequestEvent[doors.PointerEvent]) bool {
		},
	} <div id="bubble-parent">
	~>doors.AKeyDown{
		On: func(ctx context.Context, r doors.RequestEvent[doors.KeyboardEvent]) bool {
		},
	} <input id="keys-ctrl" type="text"/>
	~>doors.AKeyDown{
		On: func(ctx context.Context, r doors.RequestEvent[doors.KeyboardEvent]) bool {
		},
	} <div id="coord-target">click-me</div>
}
